Class DefaultJCacheOperationSource

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.cache.jcache.interceptor.AbstractFallbackJCacheOperationSource
org.springframework.cache.jcache.interceptor.AnnotationJCacheOperationSource
org.springframework.cache.jcache.interceptor.DefaultJCacheOperationSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanFactoryAware, SmartInitializingSingleton, JCacheOperationSource
public class DefaultJCacheOperationSource extends AnnotationJCacheOperationSource implements BeanFactoryAware, SmartInitializingSingleton
默认 `JCacheOperationSource` 实现将默认操作委托给可配置的服务，当这些服务不存在时则使用合理的默认值。
Since:
4.1
Author:
Stephane Nicoll，Juergen Hoeller

    • setBeanFactory

      public void setBeanFactory(BeanFactory beanFactory)
      描述从接口复制：BeanFactoryAware
      Callback that supplies the owning factory to a bean instance.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

      Specified by:
      `setBeanFactory` 接口 `BeanFactoryAware` 中
      Parameters:
      beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中
